description: The 22 December Okinawa protest had a reported crowd of about 2,500, but the explicit demand was that the U.S. military apologize and compensate. A resolution would be delivered to Tokyo and Washington, without a described action demanded from Japan. Threshold evidence does not resolve target eligibility.
required_followup: Find exact resolution text or contemporaneous reporting that states what Japanese officials were asked to do; otherwise retain pending_state_target.

description: KTV documents the 1 December Osaka Airin eviction protest, but supplies no count of supporters. An occurrence and state target do not establish 50 simultaneous participants.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous participant count or original photos/report with defensible simultaneity; otherwise keep pending_threshold.

description: CIVICUS reports a December protest at Kawasaki Heavy Industries’ Tokyo headquarters but gives no count or exact day. The only detailed post is a 4 December organizer announcement for 6 December; the meeting’s occurrence/date cannot be inferred from the plan, and its explicit demands are directed at the private company.
required_followup: Find a post-event, dated report with attendance and any direct demand to the Japanese government; do not treat the announcement or a count of organization members as event attendance.

description: CIVICUS calls the Seibu department-store strike a November 2024 event, but the specific Seibu search follow-up in the November unit returned Japan Times stories dated August 2023. The apparent 2024 attribution is not used to create a December event or to transfer turnout.
required_followup: Clarify whether CIVICUS intended a different 2024 event; if so, locate the exact contemporaneous report before coding.

description: Seven recorded searches used Japanese and English full-month terms plus Osaka, Okinawa, labor and Kawasaki follow-ups. Web search is not LexisNexis or systematic local-archive access; no exhaustive coverage claim is made. Historical original source ledgers and official baseline are unavailable. Native execution and response clocks were not exposed.
required_followup: Continue local/regional and issue-specific searches if needed; consult historical ledgers and official baseline only if separately provided.
